data.title: Fix bug B-docscheck-runtime-budget-flaky: docscheck README runtime budget flakes under parallel load

data.claim: cost is the corpus scan of ~13k tracked files (regex findall), idle 1.2s, so an absolute CPU budget is inflated by SMT/cache contention; a ratio to a same-process regex reference is contention-proof
data.falsifier: ratio not stable idle vs loaded, or hot spot cheap to fix
data.mechanism: findall is 0.79 of 1.48s in cProfile; reference scan shares that cost shape
data.probe: python m2.py idle and with 32 burners; cProfile tottime
data.probe_output: idle check 1.18-1.23s, ref 0.05-0.07s; with 32 burners same; findall 13176 calls 0.787s tottime; no cheap hotspot (file I/O+regex over repo)
data.question: why did check_docs(README.md) cost 2.03s CPU vs budget 2.0 under the parallel run

evidence.note: claim+probe recorded CONFIRMED; cProfile: findall 0.79/1.48s over 13k files, not README size
